# https://github.com/example-org/extension-example/blob/main/docs/README.md What is ExamplePlatform?

ExamplePlatform is a complete platform designed to build and manage next-generation network services. With its globally distributed architecture, centrally managed from a single point, ExamplePlatform significantly reduces the costs and operational complexities associated with deploying and maintaining distributed network infrastructures across cloud and edge environments.

ExamplePlatform adopts an API-first strategy, adhering to best practices in modern operations such as GitOps, Continuous Deployment, and Observability.

## https://github.com/example-org/extension-example/blob/main/docs/README.md How to use ExamplePlatform?

Depending on your goal, you can bootstrap, set up, or configure ExamplePlatform in two manners:

- through ExamplePlatform Management Console (EMC)
- through a Command Line Interface (CLI)
